scenes.headline: How Qwen-Image-2.1 computes its prompt only once
scenes.sub: A single-stream DiT, a block-causal mask, and an exact prefix cache.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Walnut! Qwen-Image-2.1 is Qwen's new open-weight image model. Here's the trick that lets it reuse its prompt across every step.

scenes.text: Modulate the prompt and reference images from t = 0, not the current step. Their keys and values then never change, so they're computed once.
scenes.say: The idea: modulate the prompt and reference images as if at time zero. Their keys and values never change, so they're computed once and reused exactly.

left.title: Qwen-Image 1.0
items: A separate stream and MLP for text
left.say: Qwen-Image one point oh used sixty dual-stream blocks, with a separate stream for text.

right.title: Qwen-Image-2.1: one stream
right.say: Two point one runs one stack of thirty-two blocks over text and image together, sharing one modulation projection. The denoiser is seven billion parameters.

steps.label: text, references, instruction, then the target
steps.say: The sequence is text and reference images, then the target. The mask is causal like a language model's, but bidirectional inside each image.

steps.label: the target: recomputed every step
steps.say: Only the target's rows change between denoising steps. Its queries attend over the fixed prefix plus the current target.

steps.label: prefix keys and values: computed once, cached
steps.note: exact, because the prefix modulates from t = 0
steps.say: And because the prefix is modulated from time zero, not the current step, its keys and values never change. Compute them once; reuse them exactly.

scenes.label: faster denoising with the prefix cache, measured on an A100
scenes.note: 2.62x predicted by the mask, with two 1024px references
scenes.say: Measured on an A100: two point five five times faster, against two point six two the mask predicts. It pays in editing; a plain prompt has little to cache.

scenes.label: licence on the weights; every earlier open Qwen image model was Apache-2.0
scenes.note: the Qwen Research License, dated 20 September 2026
scenes.say: One more change decides whether you can use it: the weights moved to a non-commercial research licence. Every earlier open Qwen image model was Apache.

scenes.text: Modulate the condition from t = 0, and a diffusion prefix becomes as cacheable as a language model's.

recap: One stream: 32 blocks over text and image
Block-causal mask; the prefix is computed once
scenes.say: To recap: one stream, a block-causal mask, and a prefix cache that's exact by construction.
